title: Recreatable LXC with persistent ZFS data
summary: Reference layout with separate retained data/config datasets, pending disposable-host backup/rebuild/restore evidence; not executable.
requirements: Reference sibling data/config datasets outside the replaceable root filesystem
Explicit UID/GID mapping and lifecycle ownership
Independent backup and successful isolated restore
verification: Recreate the guest without deleting persistent datasets
Restore data after simulated loss of the original dataset
Verify application consistency, permissions and startup ordering
